broader_bounded_claim_text: In reviewed unit-cycle records, step, seniority, rank, and COLA provisions create recurring scheduled wage-growth paths; step progression leans safety in the available sample, while across-board results are mixed and COLA cells are sparse.
canonical_claim_text_before: Step, seniority, rank, and COLA structures embed recurring wage growth rather than requiring a wholly discretionary raise each year.
evidence_that_would_falsify: Reviewed same-unit evidence consistently opposite to: In reviewed unit-cycle records, step, seniority, rank, and COLA provisions create recurring scheduled wage-growth paths; step progression leans safety in the available sample, while across-board results are mixed and COLA cells are sparse.
evidence_that_would_strengthen: Repeated same-city, same-period, same-cycle safety/non-safety contracts with harmonized pay basis, comparable roles, total-compensation components, and a credible panel or shock-based identification design.
final_claim_class_reason: The mechanism and bounded numeric evidence lean in this direction, but role, cell-size, and representativeness limits remain.
final_claim_text: In reviewed unit-cycle records, step, seniority, rank, and COLA provisions create recurring scheduled wage-growth paths; step progression leans safety in the available sample, while across-board results are mixed and COLA cells are sparse.
geographic_scope: reviewed multi-state municipalities only; not nationally representative
language_boundary: local/mechanism/sample-specific; no national wage gap, prevalence, or causal effect
prohibited_claim_text: Safety wages generally grow faster nationwide because of step progression or COLAs.
report_body_wording: In reviewed unit-cycle records, step, seniority, rank, and COLA provisions create recurring scheduled wage-growth paths; step progression leans safety in the available sample, while across-board results are mixed and COLA cells are sparse.
side_scope: explicit source-supported sides only; unresolved-side records excluded from comparative support
source_quality_summary: canonical documentary examples plus cross-examined strict/bounded administrative summaries; exact source coordinates remain in linked evidence packets
strict_claim_text: The reviewed documentary corpus contains recurring step, seniority, rank, and COLA structures; comparative growth implications remain sample-specific.
